notes.title: Save Features Patch Out Now!
notes.notes:
Defenders of the Unholy Realm!

After thorough testing, we are confident and excited to push out our first Patch to you all!


New Features & Fixes:

 The game settings now save. 
 Both game modes have a save system now. They got a new screen (we love Kaii's goat art) and you can choose between "Continue Run" and "New Run". The game automatically saves each wave at the start of your turn. 
 The text for healing units has been updated to be less confusing.
 We fixed a minor sound bug.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045035/37b64dd4a04b0d53126c45f28032772b67bb9aad.png

We know that there are still soft freezes that impact your experience. Our priority for the past weeks was to get a functioning save system into our game. At the same time, we hope that the save system, and thus the possibility to load the game after a soft freeze, helps your experience overall.

Thank you for your continued support,

Kaii, Kevin, Arnd

notes.title: We are working on our first Patch!
notes.notes:
Defenders of the Unholy Realm,

We wanted to take a moment to extend our deepest gratitude to you all! Thank you for buying the game, wishlisting, writing a review, and discussing and helping each other in the community section.

Your support has helped us climb up to the top five of New & Trending within the Roguelike Deckbuilder tag! We could not be any happier right now!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045035/c4ffad3792335e9b607408e5236bf0771c4a1652.png

To address some of the important topics in the community:


 Some of you have asked for specific display resolutions for the game.
Sadly, this is something we will not be able to offer as the base resolution of the game simply does not scale to these resolutions while staying pixel accurate.

 We are currently working on a system to save your game settings and are confident we will roll out this feature with a patch next week.

 Saving in the game modes is also being worked on, and we are exploring options on how to implement this much-requested feature.

 We will also reword ability texts of cards with healing abilities as they have caused some confusion.

 The Metal Queen Dungeon Soundtrack is going to hit the store next week! Go ahead and wishlist the soundtrack if you have not done so yet!


There is a lot to do and we are looking forward to making the experience of Metal Queen Dungeon even better!

Keep bonking,

Your KRAKL Games Team
